name: youtube-distribution
description: YouTube operator skill for founders and brands: packaging, Shorts, channel audits, distribution and attribution, India-first.

interface.shortDescription: YouTube strategy for founders and brands, built on real numbers
interface.longDescription: Turns ChatGPT into a YouTube operator for founders and brands whose channels must build trust, leads and sales. Packages titles and thumbnails with the 4Cs, scores Shorts with a Pre-Upload Gate, packages podcast episodes, audits channels with honest baselines that exclude likely-paid views, checks clipping and fan-page vendors for inflated numbers, and sets up YouTube attribution. India-first: English, Hinglish or regional by audience tier.
defaultPrompt: Audit @groww. What should they do next week?
